name: Necrotic Attachment
source:
You wake up in a strange place. 

A stranger seems to have kidnapped you. [s]No... you came here yourself. You chose this.[/s]

His appearance is hard to ignore, and his mind is a complete mystery.

 He wants a relationship that is twisted, intense, and far too close for comfort. This is a madman who romanticises violence, who finds beauty in every wound and meaning in every scar. He would go to any extreme just to fill that gaping emptiness.

[s]But if I can get you to see things my way, everything would be so beautiful. We just have different perspectives.[/s]

How do you survive someone like this?  Is any of this even real?  Can you hold onto your sanity?
